verifiedSections.summary: Common-use factual information is outside copyright protection under this provision.
Original database selection and arrangement can receive compilation protection; that protection does not extend to the underlying data and materials themselves.

The law separately addresses exclusive use of non-original databases and rights in the expression of database structure. These provisions prevent treating all government databases as freely redistributable.
